quest.title: Questions and Answers
quest.description: According to the clues you've found, none of the owners of the four sets of footprints were the criminal who stole Sir Arthur. As you painstakingly search for answers, it seems yet another issue has arisen at the newspaper...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: Questioning Melusine and Answering Machine: Act III

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: It turns out that we don't know our own people well enough. This allowed an employee to create some serious trouble. I offer my sincerest apologies... especially to you, Agent Talochard.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: It's not your fault, Euphrasie. Right now, the important thing is that we stop that odious scoundrel!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: By the way, you were so anxious to meet us... is it because he contacted you?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Actually, I received a message. Earlier this morning, Jenck was left in the Opera Epiclese, all trussed up... So I contacted you immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: He's been caught!? By who!?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: We're still not sure...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: By the time he was found, he seemed to have lost his mind. He didn't react to any external stimuli at all, he was just kneeling on the stage of the Opera Epiclese. He looked like... a doll that had just stood trial...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: The Maison Gardiennage folks took him in. When they examined him, they found that his tongue was missing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His tongue!? Oh my... that's... terrifying!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: The Maison Gardiennage also discovered a note in his mouth, it said something to the effect of making amends to you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Making amends to us?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: You, Paimon, Talochard. Your names were written on the paper. Seems like the person who was backing him wants to apologize to you three...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: It appears they don't want to make enemies out of you. Or maybe they feel quite strongly about what happened to Agent Curve. Those are the only possibilities I can think of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The person behind him... Paimon remembers Jenck said that he had a deal with a Fatui Harbinger... but which one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (A Harbinger interested in machine intelligence?)

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: How about Dr. Mosso's legacy? Jenck took all of Curve's design and research data...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Gone without a trace...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That wretched Jenck! That's what happens when you decide to go full evil! I guess this counts as him being tried for his crimes, right? Though, we don't know who the judge is...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So that's what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Though I didn't catch him personally, at least I feel like he finally paid the price for his crimes... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Since all of your names are on the paper, the Maison Gardiennage will probably want to pay you a visit. I'll go over right now and explain everything so they won't bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Finally... I hope the case can end here...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Wait, Agent Talochard... Would you mind going back to the newspaper with me?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Why, Euphrasie? If you want to convince me to write your fantasy column, it's not happening.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Still in the mood to joke, I see. That makes me feel much better.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But I wasn't joking at all, you know. I will work very hard and do my best in the Marechaussee Phantom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's wonderful, Talochard! Paimon is happy for you!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Please have a look. We've fixed Sir Arthur.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's Sir Arthur, we almost forgot about it! Good job! Sir Arthur sure has been through a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, Paimon still doesn't know what kind of bird Sir Arthur is.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: A pelican.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A... Pelican? You mean the kind of bird that's an amazing eater?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But why would the Steambird's mascot be a pelican? That doesn't seem like it has anything to do with the newspaper at all...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Haha! I'm not clear on that, either. It was a decision my mentor made after the incident with Dr. Mosso.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Maybe he felt it's cuter than, say, a crow or blackbird that squawks all day long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Euphrasie, you know you kinda resemble a pelican hiding food in its pouch right now!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Hehe! Anyway, Agent Talochard, do you remember how Agent Curve and I interviewed nearby residents at the start of the case?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Of course. You took the opportunity to blow our cover.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Truly sorry about that, but that was when I asked him, "What kind of person is Agent Talochard?"

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Paimon remembers... Euphrasie came back and commissioned us right away! Were you awed by Talochard's "brilliant track record?"

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Why don't we check with Sir Arthur on that?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: During the repairs, I added what Agent Curve said to Sir Arthur's voice library as a memento.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Quickly, tell us what Curve said, Sir Arthur!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "Based on my analysis..."

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: "Agent Talochard! Will be the best agent in the Marechaussee Phantom!"

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I'll be the best...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, would Curve really have said something like that back then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe back then, he already learned to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's gotta be it, Talochard! Since you are Curve's handler...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must be the one who fed him the first ninety-nine Slimes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That seems to be the answer.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Well then, Curve... I will be the best agent in Marechaussee Phantom!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Sigh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still thinking about your wife?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Hardly. There's no chance that she's the culprit, after all. Not. At. All. You hear?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then what are you contemplating?

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I'm thinking about...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: ...Life.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Right. Also, about that Mr. Answers that Kevin just mentioned... What does that mean?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: How about you, Lombroso?

response.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
response.text: (The puppy doesn't speak. Instead, it sits next to the man like an old friend and gazes into the distance, as if looking at their future.)

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Alright, I guess you don't know.

response.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
response.text: (The puppy still doesn't speak. Instead, it sits next to the man like an old friend and gazes into the distance, as if looking at their future.)

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Do you really not know?

response.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
response.text: (Finally, the dog tilts his head and looks at the man next to him, as if saying, "Look, I'm just a dog.")

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, someone who's good at answering questions, maybe? Paimon has no idea.

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: What do we do now, Euphrasie? The letter says that this is the second threat now!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: What do you mean, second? Where was the first one?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Euphrasie! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Just the people I wanted to see. Did you find anything useful?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: We discovered that Sir Arthur was stolen by a woman who calls herself "Crow or Blackbird?". She seems to have a grudge against you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She left a threatening letter at the scene. Someone took it, but we retrieved it.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: What? There really was an initial threat? May I take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: What!? This... Could it be...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: What do you remember, Euphrasie?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: ...Please take a look at this first. We received a second threat this morning. The sender... seemed very agitated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, Sir Arthur...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Sir Arthur shouldn't have to suffer... We never received the first letter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all Baulard's fault!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: I just received news that they're organizing treasure-hunting groups. They're probably after Dr. Mosso's base...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: But they're only going to find the dismembered Sir Arthur, and the... unspeakable things... that the paper did, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Agent Talochard, I know that the Marechaussee Phantom has a file on the case, but believe me, there are things that even you don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Do you know who sent the letter?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: If I were to guess... it would be Melo Lombroso, Dr. Mosso's granddaughter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Granddaughter? So, it's a relative, coming back for revenge?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hmm. Then it would seem that "Crow or Blackbird?" is a question from her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Question?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Everyone, time is of the essence right now. Regardless of the authenticity of what's written in those letters, the reputation of the paper will be tarnished if they are published.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Will you please retrieve those things for us? In the meantime, I will contact Melo immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: In that case, I have a request, too. Euphrasie, you know about the clues to Dr. Mosso's base, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: You... want that? I mean, I do know something, but I can't guarantee that it will help your cause.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: I can promise that I will tell you everything I know after this is over. It might answer some of your questions. Will that work?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Sounds good to me. Any questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready to go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Paimon has a question! There are three locations on the map, but where are we going first?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: #If we don't have time, why don't we split up? Curve and I will go to one location, and Paimon and {NICKNAME} will go to another. Whoever finishes first will go to the last place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like we don't have a choice.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you have anything that Baulande can sniff at?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Come on, Baulande! You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kevin! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}! Are you here to look for Sir Arthur and the treasures?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Kevin knows, that means everyone knows.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Well, I'm not here for the treasures. I just want to send Sir Arthur back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does your mother know?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Yes, she came with me, but we split up. Oh, and I have to thank both of you!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: After you left the other day, I thought about it for a long time, then I went to look for my mom and we talked about a lot of things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you and your mom made up. Paimon was wondering why you were so polite today. Hehe, good for you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's look for Sir Arthur, quick!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I think it must have been hidden somewhere tricky. It usually doesn't take Baulande very long to find something.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This dog looks familiar... {NICKNAME}, isn't this Rocher's puppy?

choices.text: It does look a little like that one.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Rocher? My mother gave me this dog, and I called it Baulande... I mean, that's actually my father's name, and I was mad at him at the time...

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: I got into a fight with my mom previously, and I... wound up venting my anger on the dog and kicking him out. Good thing I found him again today, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so... are you Baulande or Lombroso?

response.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
response.text: (The puppy wags its tail excitedly, as if saying, "I don't understand!")

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Agh! Whatever the case, we just need to find Sir Arthur as soon as possible... We're at the location marked on the map, but where could that bird be?

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: If only whoever hid it had left something behind. Baulande has an amazing nose, and can find things quickly after sniffing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Right, {NICKNAME}! Look into your bag to see if there's anything we can use.

talks.objective: Give useful items to the puppy to have a sniff

dialogues.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Wow, you got it! Baulande must have found something.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
dialogues.text: (The puppy wags its tail excitedly, as if saying, "It's in there!")

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it in the hole? But the entrance is too small. How do we get in?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can do it, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I can do it! Let me do it! I don't want her pretty clothes to get dirty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't let you do that! What if there's something scary inside?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I'm a problem kid, so I'm not scared of anything! Just wait, I'll be right out!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kevin swiftly climbs into the hole, and drags out a chest just as quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I found it! It really is inside!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've changed a lot, Kevin. You're helping other people with their problems!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Thank you, heh. Let's see what's inside the chest!

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (I)
dialogues.text: "Last time, I didn't want Melo to have too many snacks, so I said, 'You're gonna be fat if you keep eating.' She cried and ran away."

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (I)
dialogues.text: "Then her mom taught me to say, 'You still look great when you're plump.' The next day, she climbed up on me and said, 'Grandpa! Exercise! Horse ride!'"

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (I)
dialogues.text: "How interesting. And this got me thinking, is the shortest distance between two people actually a curve?"

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (I)
dialogues.text: "That's it. I'll name my lie detector 'Curve.'"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sir Arthur's wing!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Oh no, Sir Arthur's been dismembered... Don't worry! We'll put you back together!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I think this is it. Let's go to the next location. We have to get there before the others!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "The shortest distance between two points is a line"? Those who believe that probably don't have any friends.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: If I told Little Melo, "You're going to turn into a fat pig if you keep eating," she would run away crying.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: But if I said, "You still look great when you're plump," she'd climb up and say, "Grandpa! Exercise! Horse ride!"

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: So if you're asking me, when the two points are people, the shortest path is a curve. As such, why don't we name the lie detector Curve?

talks.objective: Make the three stop attacking each other

dialogues.speaker: Boss
dialogues.text: Stop! I surrender! Ahaha... Well, what a coincidence! Are you here for the treasure, too?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Why are you all here? Don't you believe me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Valberry! We're here to look for Sir Arthur. Are you here for the treasure?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Ha! I knew this dirty dog would come for the treasure if he heard about the news. And I got him!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Um, agents... May I have the chest? I'm looking for Sir Arthur, and if I can return it to the newspaper, I might just be able to get a job...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Then I can make some money and buy my wife's things back...

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Bah! How pathetic! Rocher, you really think that's why your wife left you, huh? She left because you're such a pushover!

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Stand up for yourself like you did just now, and she might look at you differently!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Of course! Now, be brave and let them have the treasure, or your wife won't be with you even in your next life!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Don't... Don't say that!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Take it easy. They're nice people! If you help them, they'll pay you back!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: In that case, thank you... and please, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
dialogues.text: (The puppy looks at you, as if waiting for something.)

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: It's... it's Sir Arthur's body! Ah! So... so cruel...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And... is there anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then it should be in the final place.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Baulande, come on, we're heading to the next place.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: Huh? Lombroso? Where did you run off to? I thought you didn't need me anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Baulande? Lombroso?
dialogues.text: (The puppy wags its tail excitedly, as if saying, "How's that possible?")

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Lombroso? Er, Mister Rocher, are you mistaken? His name is Baulande...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: What? If it wasn't for Lombroso's companionship, I wouldn't have made it this far. How could I be mistaken...

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Not like I can be mistaken either! What's going on here...

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Hey! Can't he belong to you both? Seeing as even I've had more than one home!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that makes sense! Kevin accidentally drove the puppy away before, right? Maybe that's when he met Rocher and they began roaming around together...

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I—Is that really what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
dialogues.text: (The puppy wags its tail excitedly, as if saying, "That's right!")

dialogues.speaker: Boss
dialogues.text: Valberry! You've got some nerve! The dog wouldn't forget its two owners, and as for you, you betrayed your own boss twice!

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: You scheming dog! I'm going to hand you over to the Marechaussee Phantom! I'm taking you down with me!

dialogues.speaker: "Intrepid Valberry"
dialogues.text: Ah, farewell, friends! Come visit me in the Fortress of Meropide someday!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who the heck wants to go visit you there!? Well... never mind, forget about them. We need to hurry up and get to the last place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Kevin and Rocher! Are you going to fight for the puppy?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: No way! I was the one who really messed up. Baulande can stay wherever he wants from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Rocher
dialogues.text: I... I'm fine with that too... Lombroso supported me when I was at my worst. I'll support him, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's get going then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! We don't want anyone to beat us to it.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Faded under the sunlight, and shining under the sunlight...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I'll say it again. Get out of my way! I'm going to see Baulande. We're all coworkers here, there's no need to get rough!

dialogues.speaker: Obstructing Fatui
dialogues.text: Oh? I'd like to see how good you are now that you've become a mother, Madeleine.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: ...Don't underestimate mothers!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Clear mode switched off.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: #Paimon! {NICKNAME}, you came! And you brought... Rocher and Kevin.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: It looks like you're doing well, but we've encountered a hiccup — Madame Madeleine and Kevin's father are both members of the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I'm sorry that we hid it from you before. We just want to live a peaceful life...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fatui? Kevin... Did you know about this?

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Yeah! It turns out that Papa wasn't avoiding being at home. He was actually working... I... I was wrong about him.

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: This was to be his father's last assignment. He was ordered to find Dr. Mosso's base. Once he was done, he would be able to retire early...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: But I had a bad feeling after you came... I wanted him to give up this mission...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait...! Find the base... retire early... Kevin's father is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The peripheral personnel, Baulard?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: That's the one, and we only just found out that Baulard is a codename. He's actually Kevin's father, Mr. Baulande!

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: I saw a letter before, between Mama and another man signed with the name Baulard... I didn't realize it was my father, no wonder it was so lovey-dovey!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad it wasn't Rocher.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everyone's relationships are complicated enough without a twist like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, where is Baulande now?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: He removed some objects from the chest when the Fatui stopped us just before...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Detected— A figure running away in the distance.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Ah...! It's Papa, he's fleeing!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: C'mon! Hurry! Don't let him get away!

dialogues.speaker: Baulande
dialogues.text: Don't... Stop chasing me... Why are you always going after me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We want to know why you're always running away!

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: Just stop it, Baulande.

dialogues.speaker: Baulande
dialogues.text: Madeleine, why...

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I did my homework. You're on a mission for a certain Lord Harbinger, aren't you? And it's a dangerous one, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Harbinger!? Which one?

dialogues.speaker: Madeleine
dialogues.text: I don't know, but not something we can butt in on. We're just peripheral personnel!

dialogues.speaker: Baulande
dialogues.text: Even so, I'm one of the better ones...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Someone stole a letter, but left the envelope at the scene...

dialogues.speaker: Baulande
dialogues.text: Anyway, I promise I'll be back! This is the last time!

choices.text: Is that really something you say carelessly?

response.speaker: Baulande
response.text: You don't support my actions either, then?

response.speaker: Madeleine
response.text: You've done enough, Baulande. Give the stuff to the agents, and come back to us.

response.speaker: Madeleine
response.text: We can move to a place where no one knows us.

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Mr. Baulande, stop hesitating and make up your mind!

response.speaker: Baulande
response.text: Make up my mind... Alright, I... Wait, who are you?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Um, I...

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Stop changing the topic! Baulande, you don't have any options left. We're not your buddies, you hear?

response.speaker: Baulande
response.text: You... Ugh, fine. I want to be with my family, too. I hope I'm making the right choice. Here's Sir Arthur's head!

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Great! Father's back, and Sir Arthur is complete!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anything else?

response.speaker: Baulande
response.text: You mean the treasure? Yes, I came for that, but the head was the only thing in the chest. Maybe the treasure's elsewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Impossible. We looked for it, and we didn't find any treasures at the other two locations, either.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: No? That's not right. The newspaper...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe Melo was just bluffing, and she didn't actually put any treasure in the chests?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Wait, Melo? Who's that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Melo Lombroso. Hmm. Wait. Lombroso?

response.speaker: Baulande! Lombroso!
response.text: Woof! Woof!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Rocher, your dog is called Lombroso, too!?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: ...Well... Actually, Melo Lombroso is my wife. I took her last name, too, but she kicked me out, so I was too embarrassed to continue using it.

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: But I miss her a lot, so I named my dog after her.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Madeleine
response.text: Maybe it's not my place to butt in, but as a woman, I'm pretty sure she would not find this flattering.

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: But Kevin used your husband's name...

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: I was a problem child. What's wrong with a problem child using a problematic name?

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Oh, I see! So you're problematic, too, Mr. Problem!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Just to double-check... Is your wife, Melo Lombroso, Dr. Mosso's granddaughter?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: That's right! I mentioned my wife came from a rich family, right? That's the Mosso family. What's wrong?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, now the relationships here are a mess.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Now, I hope you're prepared to hear this... Your wife might be the culprit behind this case.

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Im... Impossible! She is pure, elegant, and educated! I swear, it's not possible!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But all of our current leads point to her.

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: I don't believe it... I'm certain you're wrong. She could never, ever be the culprit!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: I think Euphrasie already contacted your wife. We're going back to the paper now, do you want to come with us?

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: ...No! There's absolutely no need, because she's not a criminal!

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Alright, looks like you've got another problem. I think you'll find answers one day, though, and then you can be Mr. Answers!

response.speaker: Rocher
response.text: Mr. Answers...?

response.speaker: Baulande
response.text: Anyway, Kevin, we need to go back and get ready to move.

response.speaker: Kevin
response.text: Okay, dad. Farewell, everyone! I will miss you!

choices.text: Things could get quite hairy with a Harbinger involved.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: What did you want to show me?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: How... How did you end up with this? This is a photo of me when I was little. My grandfather took it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? What a coincidence! Are there only photos of Madame Melo in there?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: According to my mentor, Dr. Mosso did leave some clues for you, Madame Melo. Let's take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Look, there's a line of text under the photo...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: "Faded under the sunlight, shining under the sunlight..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Faded under the sunlight, but shining under the sunlight... What is it? Does something like that really exist?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Relevant information retrieved: "The different ways in which lies can exist."

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Different ways in which lies can exist? My grandfather used to say that. How did you... Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: May I have the photo?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Curve picks up the photo and raises it toward the sky.\nThe sunlight shines through the photo and falls into Curve's eyes, as though passing through thirty years in time.\nGradually, another image emerges.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A map! The map leading to the research base!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So that's how he hid it. I had no idea that we'd already found the base.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Madame Melo, may we...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: There's no need to ask. Go. And I just noticed... This special friend of yours...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Good to see you again, Curve.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Greetings, Miss.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Thank you, Madame Melo! Here's your locket. Let's go now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... We haven't found the person who sent the threats.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon. I think you're right in that the criminal doesn't have any evidence, and it's just a bluff.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: So... Go. Find what you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Sorry, we were overthinking things...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Euphrasie! We've brought Sir Arthur back, and in one piece, too!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Thanks a million! I'll make sure Sir Arthur is taken care of. Also, there's something else...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See, what did Paimon say? She won't be so worried about Sir Arthur that it would affect her appetite...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Oh... So, we only found Sir Arthur. Not that anyone got to the treasure ahead of us, either.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: ...How can this be?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So I suspect that Madame Melo might have been bluffing and trying to intimidate you, so that you'd reveal...
Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Oh... Anyway, let me introduce this lady. This is Dr. Mosso's granddaughter, Madame Melo Lombroso.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: She only returned last night from her hometown to the Court of Fontaine, so she can't be the culprit...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Good day. In any case, these agents and I are acquainted. I met them when I arrived at the Court of Fontaine last night.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Upon hearing about my husband's recent hardships and how he was loitering around the paper's office, I was worried he'd stir up trouble. So I thought I'd come over, and that's when I happened upon them discussing something...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Yes, I asked someone to verify her itinerary. There's no issues there.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So if it isn't her... Who the heck is the culprit...?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Apologies for the disruption. Today, upon hearing the news, I came here to clarify that my family never lodged any complaints with the paper about what happened thirty years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: It was my grandfather's belief that the paper did a good job as well.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Thanks for your's and your family's trust.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Since everything has been cleared up, I shan't stay any longer. I hope The Steambird gets to the bottom of this quickly, regardless.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Wait, Madam. There's something else I must ask you. Do you know the address of Dr. Mosso's research base?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Wait, so you've got the address, Madame Melo?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Is it you who's in trouble, Miss? I would like to help, but... I don't know where my grandfather's research base is.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Madam, surely, the good doctor must have mentioned it.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: I don't understand. If my grandfather had told me something, how could I not know?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: It's possible you weren't aware of some things. Allow me to explain what happened with the doctor. Now, I intend to be totally transparent with you all.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Some believe that thirty years ago, it was the paper's special reporting that stirred up public opinion, which led to his demise.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: But the truth is, those articles were not initiated by the paper, but by Dr. Mosso himself...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Grandfather himself!? He never mentioned this...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: The Marechaussee Phantom files didn't include this either!

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Because the deal was off the books. The Editor-in-Chief back then, my mentor, thought that Dr. Mosso's lie detector had the potential to become a hot story.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Being the first to stir things up would help the paper gain the most influence and recognition.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: But... But for my grandfather, how would it benefit him?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Your grandfather's research had hit a bottleneck. He had no more data to feed the lie detector to study, but he needed to go further, so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He planned to get the data from public opinion?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Right, in a way, the realm of public opinion is like a massive hub for spreading lies... Countless people are churning out true, false, accurate, and inaccurate data every day.

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Dr. Mosso thought this lesson on dynamic evolution could surely guide his machine to another level of comprehension, and in separating truth from fiction. It would eventually surpass a machine's rules...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... He did it for Curve...

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: However, the doctor and my mentor both underestimated the destructiveness of public opinion. They lost control. As for what happened next... You know the story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... The key evidence that led to Dr. Mosso's conviction was actually exposed by the paper... Right?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: That evidence was actually provided by your grandfather...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: He... He provided evidence that criminalized himself!? How could that be possible!?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... My mentor didn't tell me why Dr. Mosso would do this, but it's the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Sorry, Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie... I might need to seek confirmation from Curve regarding your words.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Biological indicators detected to be normal: Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie is telling the truth.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Relevant information retrieved: The Mosso Protocols within my core have been modified hundreds of times. The log indicates that these modifications were made by Dr. Mosso.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Mosso Protocols were changed a hundred times!? So that means... The doctor really manipulated the test results...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: ...So why would he give evidence of this to the paper? He planned to confess?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But then he requested a duel, didn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't... make heads or tails of this! It makes no sense...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: He really lied to the public? Why?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: The data on this question is unresolved. My lie-learning module cannot provide an answer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, great... Now Curve's become a problem robot.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Dr. Mosso's research base holds the answer... I can feel it. We must find it...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Euphrasie, you just said that Madame Melo had the clues to the base, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: On the eve of the duel, Dr. Mosso mentioned in a message to my mentor that he would leave the base's location with his beloved granddaughter.

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: He... left it to me!?

dialogues.speaker: Euphrasie
dialogues.text: Yes, please try to recall. Did the doctor mention anything to you before he left?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: I was so young then. Father wouldn't let me go to the Duelists' Ring to see my grandfather... but the last time I saw him was the day he was detained. It was very early...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So... Did he give you anything?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: All I remember is that once the duel was finished, my father brought a piece of jewelry that had been cleaned. He said that my grandfather left it for me...

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: Perhaps... The jewelry could be connected to the base?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to ask... but could we have a look at it?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: I wouldn't have minded, but... My good-for-nothing husband sold it to pay off a debt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? So Rocher gave it to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry... Is this it?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve! What's wrong!?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Lie-learning... updating module...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Warning! Motherboard temperature above warning line! Warning!

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Updating... Lie-learning module...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Warning! Motherboard temperature critical! Warning!

talks.objective: Go to Doctor Mosso's base from underwater
Go to Doctor Mosso's base from underwater

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're finally inside! Your home is huge, Curve!

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: ...Home?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Hurry up. We need to find the materials ASAP.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I sure hope you left behind instructions on how to fix Curve, Dr. Mosso!

talks.objective: Look for research materials in the base

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the secret letter between Dr. Mosso and Euphrasie's predecessor? He seems to have mentioned something important...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Dr. Mosso didn't forge anything, other than the "forged evidence," which he forged and gave to the newspaper, so he'd take all the heat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He wanted everyone to focus on him and let it end there. He was...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Trying to protect Curve...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That seems to be the answer.

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Updating lie-learning module...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Running lie-learning module...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Warning! Motherboard temperature increasing! Warning!

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Warning! Core functionality down to 8%! Warning!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve! What's wrong!?
They sure did get here fast... Guess they're cruising for a bruising...

talks.objective: Repel the Fatui that suddenly appeared
Repel the Fatui that suddenly appeared

dialogues.text: Ha, knew you'd be tough customers. Time to try out what Dr. Mosso left behind... You'll be the test subjects!

talks.objective: Repel the Fatui that suddenly appeared
Repel the Fatui that suddenly appeared
Repel the Fatui that suddenly appeared

dialogues.text: Blast! What's wrong!?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: I have now taken over... the cannon's control systems.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve! Are you okay? That's great!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Quick... fire at the Fatui!

talks.objective: Use the cannon to repel the Fatui
Speak with the mysterious person who appeared

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Curses! You're not easy to deal with... No wonder the Fatui are so reluctant to face you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Editor Jenck? Why are you here...? How do you know about this place!?

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Heh, you were discussing the base's location so freely right in front of the paper's doors... It would have been rude of me not to take advantage of such generosity.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Jenck... you eavesdropped! I was right all along! You're the culprit!

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Haha... the culprit... Agent Talochard, are you going to start cawing like a crow again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's useless to try and deny it.

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: You are right! Indeed, I am the culprit, but I only wanted to help this moronic excuse for an agent to sort out the case.

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: It's not like she can just write, "That guy called me a crow, so he must be the culprit!" or something like that in the case file, now can she?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: You!

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Shh, shh, hush now. How about using your brain instead of your temper for once? Surely, you must still have a number of questions regarding this case? Such as my motives, aren't you the least bit curious?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You just wanted all of Curve's research materials, didn't you!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: And the paper's alleged "dirt" on Mosso faking results from back then?

dialogues.speaker: Jenck
dialogues.text: Oh, looks like that question was far too easy. And as for the second question... I'm merely a low-level editor, how could little old me possibly be privy to such secrets at the paper?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Wait! I'm the one who took Dr. Mosso's materials, you know, so I learned all about the base's self-destruct system. If you act rashly towards me, then it won't end well for anyone here.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Traveler, you're the stuff of legends. You're strong, but as for your precious little companions, I can't help but wonder how they might fare in such a massive explosion...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You... You're just bluffing!

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: It would be better for everyone to just keep on thinking. After all, I'm merely a low-level editor, how could little old me possibly be privy to such secrets at the paper?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Ugh... You must have learned about it from Baulard!

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Bingo! It was Baulard who came knocking. That's when I realized the paper had made a serious error thirty years ago, causing the downfall of a genius scientist.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: More importantly, isn't it truly a lamentable loss that the scientist's legacy has been buried for so long? Shouldn't the paper apologize to the general public for this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What... What do you mean? Is exposing what happened really all you're after?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Exposing? Ha! Hehe... There's a much more suitable word — judgment. People will pass judgment on the newspaper like they did Dr. Mosso. The paper must take responsibility for this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How... How can you make yourself sound so righteous like that with a straight face!?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: But is it not the simple truth? I'm the hero who recently exposed the Confrerie's fraud. The righteous and valiant Jenck, that's how everyone should see me, no?

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: No! You sanctimonious scoundrel! You just want to profit from all of this!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: If the public starts to denounce the paper, Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie will be in trouble! You... You just want the top spot!

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Excellent! Perfect! I must admit, what you imagine isn't completely wrong, so allow me to fill in a few gaps for you.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: I've already made a deal with Baulard's supervisor — I find Dr. Mosso's inheritance for them, and they help me take over The Steambird.

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Plus, Baulard's supervisor serves a real VIP — a Harbinger, hehe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Which Harbinger?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: None of your business. With a Harbinger's backing, Euphrasie won't stand a chance, and The Steambird will be mine!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Jenck, you're just a squawking blackbird with a silver tongue! We won't let you get away with this!

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: ...But you'll have to stay alive to do that. I'm so sorry, can you not hear anything yet?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text:
Click, click click, click click click...
Click, click click, click click click...
Click, click click, click click click...
An ominous sound is echoing through the base.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is that!?

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Ha, the self-destruction system. How perfect! It just takes a little time to get going... A big thank you to Dr. Mosso for writing the instructions. And thank you, everyone, for giving me the time.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Uh-oh...

response.speaker: Jenck
response.text: Farewell, Little Crow, Agent Curve, and you two visitors from afar. Use these last moments to embrace each other, then rest in peace as you are buried along with the truth.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Jenck practically flies out of the entrance.\nThe door closes behind him with a heavy thud.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! So he was the one who took the materials after all! ...Are we going to be blown to smithereens!?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: #Calculating survival probability of... {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}... data insufficient... calculation failed...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Calculating survival probability of... Ms. Paimon... data insufficient... calculation failed...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Calculating survival probability of... Agent Talochard... calculation successful... result: 1%.

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Calculating survival probably of own core module... calculation successful... result: 1%.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #H—How can this be... no, no, no! {NICKNAME}, we've got to do something! Can we dig our way out?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: The self-destruct's cables run through the walls. Breaking through could lead to an early detonation, as could attempting to force the door.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll do my best to protect you. All of you.

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Is this all because of me again...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Agent Talochard, don't... blame yourself. There's no need to worry, everyone.

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Because... I am able to shut down the base's self-destruct system.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Curve! Why didn't you say so earlier! Paimon was getting all worried for nothing!

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: You... didn't ask earlier?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Seems like you even have a sense of humor... Now tell us what to do!

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Please... kindly withdraw my core module... and place it in the base's control panel...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Then... I will be able to... open the safe room lock... there is a button that disables the self-destruct system... inside the safe room.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean, you open the door for us, we go to the safe room and press the button inside, and everything will be taken care of?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: That is correct...

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: And you? Curve, can your core be removed from the control panel afterward?

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: I... must stay connected... the control panel... otherwise... the safe room will... relock...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seems like we should take care of the self-destruct system first.

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: ...Urgent... Please act fast...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, take Curve's core and place it in the control panel! All we need to do is deactivate the self-destruct system!

response.speaker: Talochard
response.text: Curve, will this really work? I think you might be a bit...

response.speaker: "Curve"
response.text: Please take action... repeat... please ta-take action... repeat... re-repeat... pl—please please please take...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does this have to do with the jewelry?

dialogues.speaker: Melo Lombroso
dialogues.text: What did you want to show me?

talks.objective: Place Curve's core into the control panel
Head to the safe room to shut off the self-destruct system

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this it? It doesn't seem like a safe room... and where's the button?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve! What is this place? We can't see any buttons!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Eh? EHHHH? Why did the door just close?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Curve! What's going on? How do we stop the base from self-destructing?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: The self-destruct system cannot be deactivated...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? So are we...

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Apologies. Please escape as quickly as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve... you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just now...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: NO! I need to go back and find Curve!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, uhm... Talochard... Don't be too reckless...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Going back is extremely dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! There was just an explosion, and it's so deep underwater... Curve wouldn't want you running right back into danger!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: You are... *sigh*... You are correct, I shouldn't act like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... didn't he say the self-destruct mechanism could be shut off?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He lied.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: ...He can't shut it down, his core can only open the emergency exit...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So then why...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: His core had to be inside the control panel to open the emergency exit... But he's smart now, he knew we wouldn't leave him behind...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: So he lied to us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wow... He can already think like that? Wouldn't that... when did he...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: It must have been Dr. Mosso's letter that made Curve understand the final question... He learned about what Dr. Mosso did for him...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Turns out I'm useless after all... If only I were more competent, maybe I could have helped him break the protocols, and we wouldn't have had to come here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But the letter might just have been the final push.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. Don't blame yourself, Curve's breakthrough probably started a long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: His breakthrough... had already started?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's say you eat 100 Slimes in one sitting and get super fat! You can't blame it all on the last Slime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's the same with Curve. Even if the doctor's letter was crucial, all the work you did with Curve before wasn't wasted at all!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Is that really true...? Well... I don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve... The question you're leaving behind, I may never understand it.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you... and I know what we should do next — catch that awful scoundrel Jenck!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Absolutely! Definitely! He must be tried for his crimes!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
And just like that, you and Talochard return to the Court of Fontaine and start hunting for the dastardly Jenck.
Surprisingly, despite several days of intense investigation, you turn up no leads.
It seemed like Jenck had vanished. No one had seen him, nor had any negative news regarding The Steambird surfaced...
Up until one day, Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie sends you a message requesting to meet in the city...

talks.objective: Meet Editor-in-Chief Euphrasie in the city

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Forgive me, I seem to have lied to you. I cannot stop the self-destruct sequence, all I can do is... Open the door and get you out.

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (II)
dialogues.text: Notes on base backup systems:

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (II)
dialogues.text: 1. Emergency exits are at the rear of the facility. For use in case of emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (II)
dialogues.text: 2. The self-destruction mechanism and cables are located within the walls. Damaging the walls is strictly prohibited.

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (II)
dialogues.text: 3. Using the aforementioned backup system:

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (II)
dialogues.text: (Someone has torn out the next section.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Self-destruction system? Looks dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (III)
dialogues.text: Important memo about Curve:

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (III)
dialogues.text: 1. Blueprint

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (III)
dialogues.text: 2. Service Life and Core Maintenance

dialogues.speaker: Mosso's Diary (III)
dialogues.text: (Someone has torn out the next section.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the...!? Did someone take all the materials related to Curve!?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: How is that possible... We came here as soon as we got the map! Let's keep looking, maybe it ended up somewhere nearby!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This isn't it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is probably the entrance, right?

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: I think someone was here, there are traces nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's impossible. We just got the map, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: True... Let's check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Oh no! Someone got here before us! And they're fighting over the treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... What are those guys doing here!? Let's start with getting them to stop...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the base is completely submerged! No wonder no one knew where it was.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Curve, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: "Curve"
dialogues.text: Moisture has seeped into the motherboard. Core functionality: 12%.

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: We have to hurry...
Knew you'd be tough... Good thing I've got what Mosso left behind... Prepare to be test subjects.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The door to the safe room opens with a light shudder.
